title: fix(objectql,runtime)!: a package-less action is kept on its own owner key, and a route serves the one on its key
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` already teach that an action is keyed by its package, its object and its name, and that the router reaches an action bound to the object before an object-less one; no authored key, value or meaning changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:注册表为无包 action 按「归属对象」各留一格:平台绑定 `lead` 的 action 与环境的无对象 action 同名时两者都保留,不论注册先后;`/actions/lead/NAME` 读绑定 `lead` 的那条,其它路由读环境的无对象那条。
- 为什么改:action 的身份是(归属方、归属对象、名称),同名不同键是两条 action;路由判定所用的声明和派发执行的处理器必须来自同一条。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `action` 类型的无包槽位与 action 路由的选取,单条无包 action 的存储与读法不变(有对照测试);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(`keepPackagelessActionOwnerKeys` 与移除时的 `packagelessActionEntryToRetire`)、`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`(`packagelessActionOnRouteBeside`)、`packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` 末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts -t "own key"`,预期 12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Rule: an action is identified by `(owner, owning object, name)` (ADR-0150 D4). The platform's package-less action bound to `lead` and the environment's object-less action of the same name are two items under two keys, never one contested name. Binding first, then owner: `/actions/lead/NAME` serves the platform's item bound to `lead`; the environment's object-less item serves every other route; ADR-0150 D3's environment-first applies within one key, so the environment changes `lead` by authoring `NAME` bound to `lead`. On every route the declaration the gates judge and the handler the dispatch runs are one item's.

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: a package-less action registered over the bare slot keeps the slot's present item when its owner key is another, in that key's own slot (`keepPackagelessActionOwnerKeys`). One key keeps one item, the later registration; a stored row replaces the name's stored row on any key (the environment's store holds one row of a name). The bare-slot readers (`bareSlotEntriesOf`, `boundServedActions`) see each key's item; the removal of a stored row retires that row, never the platform's item of another key, and the next key's item takes the bare slot. New `getEnvironmentScopedActions(name)`: the environment-scoped action items of a name, one per owner key.
- `packages/objectql/src/action-package-addressing.ts`, `package-scoped-resolver.ts`: the owner-key view (`actionOwnerScopedRegistry`) reads the environment-scoped action on its own key; `PackageScopedRegistry` gains the optional `getEnvironmentScopedActions`.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`: the bare route takes the package-less action on its own key, bound first, then object-less (`packagelessActionOnRouteBeside`), where the by-name read answered another key's; beside one package holder the platform's item alone on the bound rung is served (`platformItemOnBoundRung`); the environment address `/actions/_env/OBJECT/NAME` answers `404` where another package-less action of the name is bound to `OBJECT`.
- Not changed: one package-less action of a name (stored and read as before); beside two package holders elsewhere, `/actions/lead/NAME` answers what the platform's `lead`-bound item alone answers there (no declaration); the caller-package route; the stored-row (`sys_metadata`) model.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, new top-level describe "the registry keeps one package-less action per owner key": 6 cases (4 pins, 1 one-key pin that holds on main, 1 control).
- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, new top-level describe "a route serves the package-less action on its own key, and runs that item's handler": 12 cases — `lead` serves the platform's item and runs its handler, and its `requiredPermissions` gate `lead` (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`), each in both registration orders beside 0 and 1 package holders; the environment's object-less item serves every other route in both orders beside 0, 1 and 2 holders (the 0-holder case a control); beside 2 holders `lead` answers no declaration; the environment address; controls: one key keeps one item, each package-less item alone.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablations, one per guard, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed), restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - registry keep (objectql rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` marker absent from 8 built files, present in 4 after the restore build): objectql 4 red / 2 green (the one-key pin and the control), runtime 8 red / 4 green (the controls and the one-key pin).
  - the bare route's own-key pick: runtime 2 red (`lead`, 0 holders), 10 green.
  - the bound-rung platform pick: runtime 2 red (`lead`, 1 holder), 10 green.
  - the environment address: runtime 1 red, 11 green.
- Two existing pins on the two-holder route (`[#32751]`, and `case 2` of `[#32365]`) keep their answers; the change is scoped so they hold.
- Overlap: PR #33621 edited `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` in the object-extension follow area; it has merged and this branch carries it; no hunk is shared. None of the 55 open pull requests read before the open touches the seven files of this diff.
